summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on collaboration among specialized agents to solve complex tasks. Existing methods improve MAS by refining the prompts, skills, and execution strategies of individual agents based on task feedback.
takeaways: Existing methods improve MAS by refining the prompts, skills, and execution strategies of individual agents based on task feedback.
In this paper, we propose EvoTeam, a collaboration-centric evolution framework that jointly evolves team organization, interaction rules, and individual agent skills through execution experience.
However, improving individual agents does not necessarily lead to better team collaboration.
